execution.raw_text:
```sql
SELECT 
  molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, 
  molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS molecule_name, 
  molecule_dictionary.max_phase, 
  molecule_dictionary.molecule_type, 
  compound_structures.canonical_smiles
FROM docs
JOIN compound_records ON docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary ON compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1122107'
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id ASC
```
